quests.description: Rogue bandit raiding parties are encroaching on Sunspire Valley. Slay 25 bandits to dismantle their outer warbands.
quests.objective: Slay 25 Rogue Bandits near Sunspire Valley
quests.title: Bandit Encampment Cull

quests.description: A seismic tremor has exposed an ancient subterranean sanctuary near Dawnbreak. Investigate the ruins, defeat the Corrupted Earth Elemental, and recover the Initial Core Astrolabe.
quests.objective: Investigate ruins & defeat Corrupted Earth Elemental
quests.title: Whispers of the Shattered Core

quests.description: An abnormally fierce pack of dire wolves threatens local livestock and travelers. Track the Alpha Packmaster into the Whispering Woods.
quests.objective: Track and slay Alpha Packmaster in Whispering Woods
quests.title: Hunt of the Dire Wolves

quests.description: Rogue bandits are raiding supply caravans heading to Sunspire. Clear out the dustroad encampment and recover the stolen merchant ledger.
quests.objective: Clear dustroad encampment & recover merchant ledger
quests.title: Bandits of the Dustroad

quests.description: A rampant surge of weak slimes threatens local farms around Sunspire. Defeat 50 slimes to restore safety to the countryside.
quests.objective: Slay 50 Weak Slimes around Sunspire Valley
quests.title: Culling the Slime Swarm

quests.description: Explore the sealed sun vaults beneath the mountain ridge. Defeat the Stone Watcher and unseal the ancient Solar Reliquary.
quests.objective: Defeat Stone Watcher & unseal Solar Reliquary
quests.title: The Ancient Reliquary of Sunspire

quests.description: Fierce elemental beasts roam the trade routes between Emberfall and Sylvan Haven. Defeat 40 wild beasts to secure the wilderness trails.
quests.objective: Slay 40 Wild Beasts across elemental biomes
quests.title: Hunt of the Elemental Beasts

quests.description: Align four ancient obelisks in the desert plateau during the starfall event to unlock the sanctuary of the Solar Primordial.
quests.objective: Align 4 desert obelisks during starfall event
quests.title: Celestial Conjunction

quests.description: A gigantic corrupted lotus is poisoning the woodland waters. Venture into the Heartwood Glen and sever its malignant tendrils.
quests.objective: Sever tendrils of corrupted lotus in Heartwood Glen
quests.title: Corrupted Forest Blossom

quests.description: Bloodtooth pirates have blockaded Abyssal Tideport's outer harbor. Board their flagship, defeat Admiral Bloodtooth, and dismantle their cannons.
quests.objective: Defeat Admiral Bloodtooth and dismantle harbor cannons
quests.title: Corsairs of Crimson Coast

quests.description: Nests of weak drake hatchlings are swarming the volcanic ridges. Slay 60 hatchlings before they mature into monstrous drakes.
quests.objective: Slay 60 Drake Hatchlings across Emberfall volcanic ridges
quests.title: Cull of Emberfall Drake Hatchlings

quests.description: Visit the leaders of the continent's four grand settlements and secure 4 Elemental Crystals: Crystal of Flame, Nature, Tides, and Sun.
quests.objective: Secure 4 Elemental Crystals from settlement leaders
quests.title: Seals of the Elemental Biomes

quests.description: Reclaim the Titan's Smelt hammer from the Inferno Golem deep within the magma caldera to re-forge Emberfall's mythical defense wards.
quests.objective: Reclaim Titan's Smelt hammer from Inferno Golem
quests.title: Heart of the Molten Anvil

quests.description: A rogue Obsidian Drake has descended upon the craggy peaks. Slay the beast and harvest its indestructible scales for the fortress smiths.
quests.objective: Slay rogue Obsidian Drake and harvest scales
quests.title: Scales of Obsidian Drake

quests.description: An ancient pyramid has emerged from the shifting sands. Penetrate its labyrinthian traps and vanquish the Mummy King.
quests.objective: Penetrate pyramid traps and vanquish Mummy King
quests.title: Mirage of Sunken Crypt

quests.description: Retrieve the shattered Abyssal Diadem from the throne room of the Ruined King to prevent the void forces from claiming ultimate dominion.
quests.objective: Retrieve shattered Abyssal Diadem from Ruined King throne room
quests.title: Crown of Fallen Monarch

quests.description: Infiltrate the outer perimeter of the Void Citadel and slay 3 High-HP Void Lieutenants guarding the soul warding gates.
quests.objective: Slay 3 High-HP Void Lieutenants guarding soul warding gates
quests.title: Generals of Dark Spire

quests.description: A titanic Nether Colossus prowls the void chasms. Coordinate with local hunters to bring down this monstrous construct.
quests.objective: Bring down titanic Nether Colossus in void chasms
quests.title: Behemoth of Nether Wastes

quests.description: Dark miasma oozes from Blackfen marshlands. Slay the Venomous Leviathan and neutralize the tainted springs.
quests.objective: Slay Venomous Leviathan and neutralize tainted springs
quests.title: Blight of Poisoned Fen

quests.description: Void fiends are pouring out of Blackfen abyssal rifts. Defeat 35 void creatures to stabilize the marshland borders.
quests.objective: Slay 35 Void Fiends near Blackfen
quests.title: Purge of the Void Fiends

quests.description: Shadow Cultists seek to tear open the abyss gates. Storm the Void Citadel, shatter the barrier wardens, and vanquish the Avatar of the Void before the rift expands.
quests.objective: Storm Void Citadel and vanquish Avatar of Void
quests.title: Rift of the Void

quests.description: Ascend to floor 25 of the Spire of Trials and withstand consecutive waves of empowered elemental bosses.
quests.objective: Ascend to floor 25 of Spire of Trials
quests.title: Spire Trial: Elemental Crucible

quests.description: Shape the ultimate destiny of Aetherion's Primordial Core: City Restoration (-15% vendor prices) or Elemental Surge (+15% Magic Find & +20% harvesting yield). Unlocks the Infinite Spire of Trials.
quests.objective: Choose legacy destiny for Aetherion Primordial Core
quests.title: A New Dawn

quests.description: Prove your combat dominance by vanquishing 12 empowered heavy elites inside the Spire of Trials.
quests.objective: Defeat 12 Empowered Heavy Elites in Spire of Trials
quests.title: Trial of the Vanguard Elites

quests.description: Confront the ancient Primordial Sovereign at the apex of Aetherion and prove your mastery over all elemental magic.
quests.objective: Confront Primordial Sovereign at apex of Aetherion
quests.title: Wrath of Primordial Sovereign

quests.description: Arch-Druid Elyona requests gathering luminous herbs to cleanse ancient sequoia roots of dark shadow blight.
quests.objective: Gather luminous herbs to cleanse blighted sequoia roots
quests.title: Purification of Redwood Roots

quests.description: Lord Thorn of the Forge commands an expedition into the deep mines to purge 10 high-HP Lava Hounds and restore the clogged blast furnaces.
quests.objective: Purge 10 High-HP Lava Hounds in deep mine shafts
quests.title: Cleansing the Smeltery Shafts

quests.description: Captain Valdor seeks brave divers to recover a lost reliquary compass from an uncharted shipwreck deep in sea caves.
quests.objective: Recover lost reliquary compass from shipwreck
quests.title: Sunken Galleon Treasures

quests.description: Astronomer Zahir is studying crystal desert ruins. Collect starlight prisms to calibrate the Great Bronze Astrolabe.
quests.objective: Collect starlight prisms to calibrate Bronze Astrolabe
quests.title: Starlight Lenses of Observatory
